description_en: Queries the IP addresses of Kafka clients
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka get-kafka-client-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --type byInstance --start-time 1716343501000 --end-time 1716343502000 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetKafkaClientIp

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The topic name.

This parameter is required when Type is set to byTopic
parameters.help_zh:
Topic名称。

若 Type 为 byTopic 时，必须入参该参数
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en:
The consumer group ID.


This parameter is required when Type is set to byGroup
parameters.help_zh:
消费组ID。


若 Type 为 byGroup 时，必须入参该参数
parameters.name: group

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the query type for client IP addresses. Three query methods are available:

byInstance: queries the client IP addresses of the instance within the specified time range. 
byTopic: queries the client IP addresses of the topic within the specified time range.
byGroup: queries the client IP addresses of the consumer group within the specified time range
parameters.help_zh:
查询客户端 IP 类型。可选择三种方式查询。

byInstance： 查询实例指定时间范围内的客户端 IP。 
byTopic： 查询 Topic 指定时间范围内的客户端 IP。
byGroup:  查询 Group 指定时间范围内的客户端 IP
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的结束时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Alert.description_en:
Indicates whether the minor version is not the latest.

If the minor version of your server is not the latest, the sampled logs may lack precision, resulting in inaccurate IP statistics. Therefore, upgrade the minor version of your server as soon as possible
Alert.description_zh:
若该值为 true 时，则说明小版本不是最新版本。

如果您的服务端小版本不是最新版本，会导致采样日志不够精确，最终导致统计的IP信息不够精准。因此建议您尽快升级服务端小版本

EndDate.description_en: The end time of the query result. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
EndDate.description_zh: 查询结果对应的结束时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

SearchTimeRange.description_en:
The time range for querying client IP addresses.

The time range is 1 hour. If the interval between the start time and the end time exceeds 1 hour, only data within 1 hour is queried
SearchTimeRange.description_zh:
查询客户端 IP 时间范围。

该范围为 1 小时，若输入的开始时间和结束时间超过了 1 小时，则只会查到 1 小时内的数据

StartDate.description_en: The start time of the query result. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
StartDate.description_zh: 查询结果对应的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

TimeLimitDay.description_en: The maximum time range for querying client IP addresses, in days. The current upper limit is 7 days. If the interval between the start time and the end time exceeds 7 days, only data within 7 days is returned
TimeLimitDay.description_zh: 查询客户端 IP 的时间范围上限，单位为天。当前上限为 7 天；若开始时间和结束时间的间隔超过 7 天，仅返回 7 天内的数据

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
